buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The below mentioned Buyer Added text-based ATC clauses will have privilege over SLA. 2. The Service Provider must own at least one Premium SUV (commercial/Taxi) vehicle in Service Provider’ s name or in the name of the proprietor/partner of the Service Provider. Necessary documents (RC, Insuran ce, Fitness and Permit) relating to proof of ownership MUST be uploaded by the bidder for verification of th e buyer. 3. The bidder shall submit a Solvency Certificate issued by a Nationalized Bank for an amount equivalent t o 40% of the estimated Bid value or Net Worth Certificate from Statutory Auditor, confirming positive net w orth. Audited Balance Sheets of the last three FY (2023-24), (2024-25) & (2025-26) to be enclosed as supp orting evidence. The certificate shall be valid for a minimum period of three (3) months from the date of p ublication of the GeM Bid. The bidder shall also provide the official email ID and contact number of the issu ing bank/branch. MPLSA reserves the right to verify the authenticity and validity of the Solvency Certificate with the issuing bank. 4. The vehicle should be white in color, in good working condition, well maintained, and free from any maj or scratches/dents/ any history of serious accidents. The interior and exterior of the vehicle shall be cleane d daily before reporting to duty. 5. The vehicles deployed must be equipped with the following additional accessories/utilities: a. Tool Box & Stepney. b. First aid box and torch. c. Clean Seat Covers/White Towels and Floor Mats etc. d. Hand Sanitizer e. Tissue paper box

f. Car Air Freshener g. Mobile charging facility h. Seat Belts (Front and Rear seats) i. Fire Extinguisher j. white colour curtains f. name display 6. The Vehicle shall be made available on Saturday/Sunday/Non-working days, if required. 7. In case of breakdown or servicing of the primary vehicle, the agency must provide a stand-by vehicle of similar type and condition within an hour. Failure to do so shall attract penalty @Rs500/day at every insta nce. 8. GPS-enabled vehicle tracking and mobile phone availability with driver is desirable to ensure tracking an d safety. 9. All vehicles and drivers must comply with the latest provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, pollution norms , and applicable central/state government regulations. 10. A monthly review of services will be conducted, and unsatisfactory performance may lead to appropria te penalties or termination of the contract . 11. A well-trained, courteous, and experienced driver shall be deployed. Frequent changes of driver should be avoided. Drivers deployed with vehicles must meet the following criteria, which override any SLA provis ions: a. Hold a valid driving license. b. Wear a neat and clean uniform during duty, if prescribed. Uniform costs shall be borne by the Service Pr ovider. c. Well-acquainted with the roads and localities within the Municipal Area. Preference should be given to lo cal drivers. d. Must have a mobile phone; costs shall be borne by the Service Provider. e. Exhibit professional behavior, follow proper etiquette, and maintain a courteous demean or at all times. f. Drivers found under the influence of alcohol or drugs shall be removed immediately from duty, and such incidents may lead to termination of the contract. 12. The following penalties shall be imposed in case of defaults/defect in service: a. Late Reporting: Rs 100/- per day b. Non reporting of vehicle/Driver: Rs 500/- per instance + the actual amount incurred by the department i f taxi/vehicle hired by the department from market/third party, would be deducted from bill of the Service Provider. Repeated instances may lead to termination of the contract. c. Refusal of duties: Rs 500/- per instance + the actual amount incurred by the department if taxi/vehicle h ired by the department from market/third party, would be deducted from bill of the Service Provider. Repeated instances may lead to termination of the contract. d. Non-Adherence to Dress Code: Rs 100/- per day. 13. Duty hours: The duty hour shall be normally for 10hours from 09:00 AM to 07:00 PM including reporting time. However, the duty hours can be changed based on the requirement of the office. The night charges ( 10PM to 06AM) applicable Rs.1000/- per night inclusive all for the driver. 14. All expenses relating to fuel, maintenance, servicing, insurance, challans, and driver’s salary shall be b orne by the contractor. 15. The Purchaser reserves the right to increase/decrease the quantity by 25% at the time of placement of

contract or during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The bidders shall be bound to acce pt such orders as and when placed. 16. Buyer reserves the right to terminate the contract anytime with a 30 days’ notice to the Service Provid er, without assigning any reason. 17. Any matters not explicitly covered under this agreement shall be resolved by the Addl. DGT, MP LSA, B hopal. The decision of this office shall be final and binding. 18. An office of the Service Provider MUST BE located in the state of consignee i.e., Madhya Pradesh (MP). Documentary Evidence to be submitted. 19. ePBG/ PBG/ EMD must be from Nationalized bank. 20. ePBG/ PBG have to submitted with in 15days from the date of contract failing to submit the same will b e liable for the termination of the contract by the competent authority as per discretion. 21. Only MSE Bidders for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Relevant supporting documents in this regard is to be submitted. 22. Toll charges or Parking charges will be paid extra on the production of the payment receipt for the dur ation of service availed. 23. Bidder should submit a documental proof regarding registered office established Branch office in Bhop al (M.P.). 24. Requisition & Deployment Protocol ● Advance Notice: Requisitions will be placed by the controlling officer via phone, email, or digital messaging with a minimum notice period of 12 to 24 hours (or shorter notice in emergent operational circ umstances). ● Approved Rate Basis: All billings shall strictly adhere to the rates finalized and approved through this ten der process (structured per day, per hour, or per kilometer slabs as per SLA). ● Billing and Payment: All payments will be subject to the actual use of vehicle as per SLA. ● Duty Slips/ Log Book: Every movement must be recorded on an official duty slip/ Log book signed by the reporting DoT official, capturing start time, closing time, starting KM, and closing KM. 25. Adjustment of unused Km on daily basis will be made within a trip itself whereas a trip will be of more t han one day in continuation during the period of service availed. . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG

Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of AO CASH CCA MPTC BHOPAL payable at AO CASH CCA MPTC BHOPAL . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C AO CASH CCA MPTC BHOPAL . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of AO CASH CCA MPTC BHOPAL A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 10. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 11. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c.
